_comment: Words that tell us what KIND of entity the sentence is about (Module 8 type check). If the sentence says 'book a table' and the best name match is a PERSON (Dr. Raju), the match does not fit and must not be resolved silently. Keys: 'business:<category>' or 'person:<role group>'. A candidate fits if its type and category/role match one of the expected keys. Places always fit (a place is just where).
